name: directional-drawer

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the drawer fully open with title, nav links and Get Started; frame 3 catches it still sliding in.
frames.render_note: Crop clips the drawer's left edge, leaving only the last letters of the heading.

tagline: A dark settings drawer slides in from the left edge of the screen.
summary: A left-side slide-in panel with a small nav list and one call-to-action button at its base. Opening it dims the page behind, and the X or an outside click closes it.
appearance: A dark panel fixed to the left of the frame, roughly 450px wide, with a white X at the top right, a bold heading, a line of grey helper text, four stacked nav links and a full-width light button pinned to the bottom.
behaviour: Clicking Open Drawer slides the panel in from the left while the rest of the page dims and blurs; the X, a click outside or Escape slides it back out. On narrow screens a drag handle replaces the X.
demo_content: Heading "Navigation" with links Dashboard, Projects, Settings, Profile and a Get Started button
search_phrases: panel slides in from the side
menu that covers part of the page
pop out sidebar with close button
slide over panel for mobile nav
use_when: Secondary navigation should open over the page without shifting the layout.
avoid_when: On desktop it cannot be dragged closed and the panel width is fixed at 450px.
customise: direction, outsideClose, open and setOpen are props; the heading, links and button are your own children.
weight_why: One slide-in panel with a backdrop blur; nothing loops.

a11y.note: The trigger is a plain div, so the drawer cannot be opened by keyboard; the X has no accessible name.

issues: The trigger is a div, so keyboard users cannot open the drawer.
The crop cuts the panel's left edge, hiding most of the heading.
polish_why: Functional slide-over with a tidy nav list; clipped crop and plain styling keep it ordinary.
